data.summary: Assistant Manager-level Middle Office professional with 8+ years of experience in Fund Services, Cash & Position Reconciliation, Investment Accounting, NAV Oversight, Trade Settlement, and Portfolio Reconciliation. Proven expertise in reviewing reconciliation packs, quality control, exception management, maker-checker activities, stakeholder management, process improvements, and fund migration support. Experienced in supporting APAC, EMEA, and NAM markets while consistently achieving SLA, quality, and operational excellence.

Experienced in supporting APAC, EMEA, and NAM markets while consistently achieving SLA, quality, and operational excellence.
